MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.title: Legacy of the Aroma Clan
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.descripti: At the start of combat, enter [gold]Attack Stance[/gold]. Gain [gold]Legacy of the Aroma Clan[/gold]: when your attack hits or you are hit, gain 1 [gold]Qi Gauge[/gold].
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.flavor: The incense line endures, and so does its Qi.
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.title: Spirit of the Aroma Clan
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.descripti: At the start of combat, gain [gold]Legacy of the Aroma Clan[/gold] and [gold]Spirit of the Aroma Clan[/gold]. Spirit reduces required Qi Gauge to gain Qi by 1.
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.flavor: Even without the old relic, the spirit keeps breathing.
MEILINMOD-LONG_YA_RELIC.title: Dragon Fang
MEILINMOD-LONG_YA_RELIC.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 Qi counters.
MEILINMOD-LONG_YA_RELIC.flavor: Before the bite, the current moves.
MEILINMOD-LONG_ZHUA_RELIC.title: Dragon Claw
MEILINMOD-LONG_ZHUA_RELIC.description: At the start of combat, all enemies gain 2 [gold]Ember[/gold].
MEILINMOD-LONG_ZHUA_RELIC.flavor: Where the claw lands, flames follow.
MEILINMOD-LONG_WEI_RELIC.title: Dragon Tail
MEILINMOD-LONG_WEI_RELIC.description: Gain 1 Dexterity in Attack Stance, and 1 Strength in Guard Stance.
MEILINMOD-LONG_WEI_RELIC.flavor: A single sweep, and force turns over.
MEILINMOD-LONG_YI_RELIC.title: Dragon Wing
MEILINMOD-LONG_YI_RELIC.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 [gold]Qi[/gold].
MEILINMOD-LONG_YI_RELIC.flavor: With one beat, initiative is won.
MEILINMOD-LONG_LIN_RELIC.title: Dragon Scale
MEILINMOD-LONG_XIN_RELIC.title: Dragon Heart
MEILINMOD-LONG_XIN_RELIC.description: If combat ends while you are in Guard Stance, heal 5 HP.
MEILINMOD-LONG_XIN_RELIC.flavor: As long as the heart burns, life returns.
MEILINMOD-LONG_YAN_RELIC.title: Dragon Eye
MEILINMOD-LONG_YAN_RELIC.description: Every 3 turns, your next [gold]Power[/gold] card costs 1 less.
